$comment: Third-party packages of the port-only modules, one manifest and one baseline for all of them (the root CMakeLists.txt installs it). Each consumer is a feature, installed only when its switch is on: rpgpu (FreelancerRpGpu, docs/re/rpgpu.md). shader-tools is not a build consumer: only the RPGPU shaders CI job installs it, for the shadercross compiler (tools/rpgpu_shaders.ps1). Retail modules may not link vcpkg packages (fl_vcpkg_package), so none of them sees these packages. builtin-baseline pins vcpkg release 2026.10.16 (SDL 3.4.18).
name: freelancer-port

rpgpu.description: RPGPU.dll, the SDL3 + SDL_GPU render pipeline

shader-tools.description: SDL_shadercross, the offline compiler for RPGPU's shaders (tools/rpgpu_shaders.ps1); not part of any build
